summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CPLRekap app with three major changes: (1) Single Price simplification (removed grosir/retail, kept only Harga SO), (2) Pabrik dropdown (BLUTO, PANDAAN, IT), (3) Laporan Tahunan (yearly profit comparison). All backend APIs and frontend UI verified successfully.

Frontend: Customer dialog has NO 'Tipe Harga Default' field
Frontend: Customer cards have NO price type badges
